title: Bridge Buddies
desc: Build and test sixty distinct bridge-load plans with unlimited free supports, from first spans to reinforced summit crossings.
mission: Build four strong spans per level across sixty increasingly demanding crossings. All supports stay free and replaceable. Move through twelve bridge-builder ranks and carry each cargo safely.
take: Choose the right support for the job. Test a small model, notice what happened, and change one thing at a time.

title: Water Works
desc: Rotate real connecting pipes through eighty increasingly winding water-flow networks and a toy filter.
mission: Solve eighty different pipe routes through the central toy filter. Advance from Flow Finder to Waterworks Grandmaster while tracing each connection.
take: Trace a problem from its starting point and check each connection. This toy filter does not make real water safe to drink.

title: Harbor Helpers
desc: Plan eighty named island deliveries with increasingly complex, exact supply requests.
mission: Fill eighty island requests using the correct crates, staying within transport capacity and progressing through sixteen helping ranks.
take: A useful delivery starts with listening. Plan loads and routes together so supplies reach the neighbors who asked for them.

title: Pantry Picnic
desc: Plan eighty distinct picnics in one saved adventure across eight food-smart chapters.
mission: Pack eighty different picnic boxes in eight connected chapters. Choose one main and two produce portions, use marked leftovers first, and resume at your next challenge.
take: Check what you already have before getting more. Planning portions can reduce waste; ask an adult about allergies, food preparation, and safe storage.

title: Compass Cove
desc: Follow sixty different landmark-and-direction routes across the island's six-by-six map.
mission: Navigate sixty unique map instructions, starting at landmarks and counting north, south, east and west steps. Some destinations are revisited by new routes.
take: Start from a landmark you can identify. A map and a compass help you explain a route and check where a direction will take you.

title: Cipher Club
skill: Make meaning with a shared key
desc: Solve sixty increasingly long code-wheel messages, with A–H letters and clues to word meanings.
mission: Encode or decode sixty different real words on the eight-letter toy wheel, growing from three letters to nine through twelve code ranks.
take: A shared rule can change how a message looks. This tiny code is easy to break and must never be used to protect passwords or real secrets.

title: Trade Town
desc: Explore 60 different shopping requests through six saved market districts, from bundle basics to extra-fee comparisons.
mission: Work through 60 different shopping requests across six saved market districts. Compare quantities, whole costs and fees; progress resumes next visit.
take: The biggest pack is not always the best fit. Compare the whole cost, including fees, with how much you actually need.

title: Critter Council
desc: Listen to 240 different neighbor requests while building sixty welcoming woodland neighborhoods.
mission: Advance through sixty town-planning levels. Place a shaded park, quiet reading hut, step-free ramp, and bench so every set of four neighbor requests is met.
take: People can need different things from the same place. Ask, listen, and design so more neighbors can take part comfortably.

title: Traffic Town
skill: Read traffic signs & choose safe actions
desc: Cruise through a friendly practice town and learn 120 common U.S. road signs through dimensional sign models.
mission: Travel through 120 different sign challenges in twelve connected chapters. Every included sign gets its own level, meaning, 3-D sign model, and saved checkpoint.
take: Traffic Town teaches common U.S. sign patterns for early road awareness. Real driving requires the official rules where you live, adult supervision, and age-appropriate licensing.

title: Street Safety Scout
desc: Spot signal lights, caution and emergency signs, vehicle lights, roadside warnings, and hidden street hazards.
mission: Complete fifteen visual safety stops per route, balanced across five safety categories. Practice all sixty distinct scenarios across four no-repeat routes.
take: Notice the clue first, then choose a calm, predictable action. Always follow current local signs, officials, emergency directions, and the rules where you live.

title: Pocket Planet
desc: Explore all sixty different gardening, building and food-preparation projects in one saved six-chapter adventure.
mission: Complete all sixty projects across six connected chapters. Pick three useful supplies, then arrange three real-life-inspired making steps. Each finished project saves in this browser, without coins or purchases.
take: Choose useful supplies, prepare safely with an adult when needed, and learn the order of steps for growing, building and cooking.

title: Scam Sleuth
desc: Investigate sneaky messages and protect your digital clubhouse.
mission: Explore 80 different suspicious messages in eight connected chapters. Spot urgency, secrecy, impersonation, payment tricks, or pressure; save progress after every message.
take: Slow down when a message asks for secrets, money, or a rushed decision. Check through a route you already trust.

title: Kindness Quest
desc: Help the treehouse crew listen, work together, and set kind boundaries.
mission: Help the treehouse crew through 60 different listening, boundaries, teamwork, and kindness decisions in six connected chapters, with saved progress.
take: You can care about someone and still say no. Ask, listen, and make a plan together.

title: Fact Finder
desc: Run a tiny news desk. Sort evidence, opinions, ads, and unchecked claims.
mission: Finish 60 source-checking news desk cards across six saved chapters, distinguishing evidence, opinions, advertising and unchecked claims.
take: A popular claim is not automatically a fact. Look for a source, context, and something you can check.

title: Repair Café
desc: Practice repair-and-care skills with sixty different challenges before replacing something.
mission: Repair 60 different objects in six connected chapters. Practice checking, planning, fixing and testing each object in the correct order. Your work saves.
take: Looking closely can save time, materials, and money. Small repairs can give things a second life.

title: Time Trail
desc: Explore sixty progressively longer trails over six chapters, from easy 5×5 paths to giant 7×7 summits.
mission: Explore sixty map levels in six chapters. Collect three, four, or five flags, plan around new rock patterns, and follow your saved checkpoint from one session to the next.
take: Plan the whole route before the first step. If a route does not work, reset and try a different one.

title: Garden Guardians
desc: Grow sixty different gardens, balance crops and pollinator flowers, and protect your water supply.
mission: Advance through sixty garden levels and twelve ranks. Match each planting plan, water wisely across three days, and earn up to three stars per garden.
take: Different plants support different needs. Sharing limited water takes planning.

title: Energy Island
desc: Power sixty different islands through changing forecasts, higher demand, and long nights.
mission: Advance through sixty energy-island levels and twelve ranks. Use limited builder tokens, read four-day forecasts, balance solar, wind, and batteries, and earn stars for reliable power.
take: Sources change with conditions. Storing a surplus can help when production drops.

title: Reuse Rally
desc: Clean up Toy Town. Reuse what you can and sort the rest.
mission: Sort all 60 different objects in six saved Toy Town cleanup chapters: reuse, recycling, compost or trash. Local rules vary.
take: Using something again can avoid waste. Check your local recycling and compost rules with an adult.

title: Robot Rover
desc: Code a little rover through eighty progressive star-filled worlds and sixteen explorer ranks.
mission: Build a command list with forward, turn left, and turn right. Watch Rover's facing direction, test your path, and improve it for efficiency stars.
take: Debugging means noticing what happened and improving one part of your plan. Mistakes are clues.

title: Lemonade Lab
desc: Start an 80-mission lemonade business journey, or return to the classic four-day free-play stand.
mission: Start with eighty (80) progressively varied market contracts about supply costs, demand, prices and profits. The four-day stand remains available as free play.
take: Revenue is the money that comes in. Profit is what remains after costs. Leftovers and demand matter, too.

title: Beat Builder
desc: Master 80 rhythm-building missions or switch into freestyle studio at any time.
mission: Begin a saved eighty (80)-mission rhythm campaign with different kick, clap and hi-hat patterns. Freestyle is still available and sound remains optional.
take: A repeating pattern creates rhythm. Small changes can make a familiar pattern feel new.

title: KidsCoin Family App
desc: Explore 120 open family-finance questions through lessons, or a saved 60-mission trail. Parent approval and pretend KC stay separate.

title: Brain Sweat Expanded
desc: Explore 69 reviewed workshop activities or follow an 80-mission learning trail: source-backed practice first, then clearly labeled safe bonus challenges.

title: Brain Sweat Life Skills
desc: Learn from 60 reviewed practical questions in 12 safe lessons, or tackle an 80-mission journey with clearly labeled safe bonus practice. Unreviewed worlds stay locked.

title: Bubble Resonance Φ369
desc: Aim glossy bubbles through eighty named matching stages with rebounds, number clues, and three special powers.

title: Chill Brain Rewards
desc: Choose gentle guided sessions or explore 80 short untimed observation, comfort, focus, pattern and kindness missions.

title: Creature Catcher
desc: Catch creatures and fill your field guide, or play 60 wildlife science and habitat-care missions.

title: Road Trip Quest
desc: Enjoy sixteen city-boss adventures, or practice 60 passenger-safe travel and map-planning missions.

title: Road Trip Quest GPS
desc: Explore twenty quest levels on a private pretend map with optional live movement, or complete 60 fully offline map, safety and privacy missions.

title: Weather Watchers
skill: Read the sky & a simple forecast
desc: Look closely at realistic sky scenes, name the weather, read forecast clues, and choose a safe plan.
mission: Advance through four skill ranks and sixty different illustrated weather questions covering sky clues, cloud types, safe choices, and forecast reading.
take: The sky gives clues, not promises. Check a current local forecast with a trusted adult and follow real weather alerts.

title: Garden Grow & Harvest
skill: Build, grow, harvest & keep food fresh
desc: Choose the right picture to build a garden, plant seeds, care for crops, harvest produce, and keep it fresh.
mission: Advance through four garden-care ranks and eighty illustrated questions covering beds, planting, growing, harvesting, and safe food storage.
take: Read the seed packet, work with a trusted adult, use tools safely, and wash garden food before eating it.

title: Kids Sudoku World
desc: Solve eighty unique Sudoku puzzles in eight chapters, growing from friendly 4×4 to 6×6 and advanced 9×9.
mission: Complete 80 uniquely solvable puzzles, using each number once per row, column and outlined box. Start with number friends, gain pencil notes and hints, and unlock harder boards across eight chapters.
take: Find the missing numbers by checking rows, columns and boxes. There is no timer; everyone can learn at their own pace.

title: Word Search World
desc: Find hidden words across 60 gradually harder themed puzzles, from friendly 6×6 grids to 12×12 challenges.
mission: Explore 60 uniquely themed word-search levels across six chapters: gardens, weather, kindness, building tools, money skills, and geography. Learn across, down, diagonal and backwards words with hints, stars and saved progress.
take: Search rows, columns and diagonals carefully. Work at your own pace; the next puzzle unlocks when all words are found.

title: Crossword World
desc: Solve eighty clue-based real crosswords with crossing Across and Down words, growing harder each chapter.
mission: Finish eighty connected clue puzzles over eight increasingly difficult chapters. Start with friendly garden words and advance through weather, kindness, building, budgeting, geography, science, and word mastery; use hints, check letters, and earn stars.
take: Read each clue, look where words cross, use hints when needed, and learn how word meanings can guide each answer.

title: Creative Calm Cove
desc: Draw, stamp, mirror, swirl and invent in a no-pressure art studio with local saves and eighty optional creative prompts.
mission: Explore 80 optional creative cards across eight open studio chapters. Free draw, use mirror or radial symmetry, grow Spiro art, spark creatures, add stickers, save locally, or export a PNG. There are no wrong answers and no timer.
take: Creative practice can be playful and unhurried. Try a tool, notice what happens, keep what you like, and change direction whenever you want.
source: Original LarriVerse studio inspired by Domistika (MIT), 2026
